summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its adjourned Annual General Meeting held August 7, 2026. Shareholders approved all four proposals: re-appointment of Kesselman Kesselman (PwC member) as auditors, re-election of directors Rick D. Scruggs and Shmuel Cabilly for three-year terms, engagement of Dror Ben-Asher as Chairman and CEO, and an amendment to eliminate the par value of shares. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation features; filings detailing ordinary meeting outcomes do not qualify as a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, strategic review, capital return, or restructuring event is indicated.
